sentences.cs: Eva jde do obchodu, protože doma nemá jídlo.
sentences.en: Eva is going to the shop, because she has no food at home.
The shop is near her house.

sentences.cs: Nejdřív kupuje chléb, mléko a sýr.
sentences.en: First she buys bread, milk and cheese.
Then she looks for fruit and vegetables.

sentences.cs: Eva bere pět jablek a dvě rajčata.
sentences.en: Eva takes five apples and two tomatoes.

sentences.cs: Maso je drahé, ale ona ho chce.
sentences.en: The meat is expensive, but she wants it.
At the checkout she waits a short while.

sentences.cs: „Dobrý den, platíte kartou?“ ptá se prodavačka.
sentences.en: "Hello, are you paying by card?" the shop assistant asks.
"No, thank you, I'm paying cash," Eva answers.

sentences.cs: Taška je těžká, ale Eva bydlí blízko.
sentences.en: The bag is heavy, but Eva lives nearby.
At home she puts the milk in the fridge.

sentences.cs: Potom vaří večeři pro svou rodinu.
sentences.en: Then she cooks dinner for her family.

sentences.cs: Její dcera má hlad a chce jíst hned.
sentences.en: Her daughter is hungry and wants to eat right away.
